name: Transfers to jurisdictions with weak transparency soon after reporting changes
description: Funds shifted to non-participating or low-transparency jurisdictions around the introduction of reporting obligations or voluntary-disclosure windows.
fp: Business or investment reasons may exist for moves.

sources.text: FATF/OECD, Money Laundering Awareness Handbook for Tax Examiners and Tax Auditors (2012)
OECD, Standard for Automatic Exchange of Financial Account Information in Tax Matters (2014; 2nd ed. 2017)
OECD, Model Mandatory Disclosure Rules for CRS Avoidance Arrangements and Opaque Offshore Structures (2018)
FATF and OECD, Money Laundering Awareness Handbook for Tax Examiners and Tax Auditors (2012)
